title: Senior Procurement Manager - Marine & Heavy EPC
description: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Procurement Manager to lead our strategic global vendor sourcing and contractual negotiations for mega EPC and marine offshore projects.
responsibilities: Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans for API-grade piping, valves, marine equipment, and structural packages.
Lead commercial and contractual negotiations with international Tier-1 OEMs across Europe, Middle East, and Asia.
Collaborate with project directors to establish milestone-based procurement schedules and risk registers.
Manage port logistics, bonded warehouse operations, and customs clearance procedures.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Marine Engineering or Supply Chain Management; MBA is a plus.
8+ years of hands-on experience in EPC, Oil & Gas, or Marine offshore procurement.
Proven network of global supplier relationships and familiarity with INCOTERMS 2020.
Strong command of ERP systems (SAP/Oracle) and contract law.
benefits: Competitive executive salary with performance-linked annual bonus
Comprehensive medical insurance for family and dependents
Professional development and international conference sponsorship
Executive wellness allowance and gratuity coverage

title: Lead QA/QC & Inspection Engineer (NDT Level III)
description: Lead quality surveillance, witness factory acceptance tests (FAT), and oversee non-destructive testing for high-pressure piping and offshore structures.
responsibilities: Formulate project-specific Inspection & Test Plans (ITP) in alignment with ASME, API, and ISO 9001:2015 standards.
Execute and witness advanced NDT methods (PAUT, TOFD, Radiography) at vendor yards.
Review and approve Welder Performance Qualifications (WPQ) and PQR/WPS dossiers.
Conduct internal and supplier quality audits, managing Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) to closure.
requirements: B.E. / B.Tech in Metallurgy, Mechanical, or Production Engineering.
ASNT Level III or CSWIP 3.2 certification in Ultrasonic Testing and Radiography.
6+ years experience in heavy engineering, refinery turnarounds, or offshore fabrication.
Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII & B31.3 codes.
benefits: Competitive compensation package with offshore site allowances
Full coverage health and accidental insurance
Certification renewal and advanced testing training support
Paid annual leave and travel logistics assistance

title: Project Engineer - Utility Scale Solar & BESS
description: Manage on-site erection, testing, and commissioning of utility-scale solar PV arrays, inverter stations, and battery energy storage skids.
responsibilities: Oversee day-to-day site installation of single-axis tracker systems, string inverters, and HT switchyards (up to 33kV).
Coordinate with grid authorities and discoms for statutory safety approvals and CEIG clearances.
Supervise civil piling, module mounting structures, and DC cable trenching contractors.
Conduct pre-commissioning loop tests, I-V curve tracer checks, and SCADA telemetry sync.
requirements: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Renewable Energy Systems.
4+ years of on-site experience executing utility-scale (>50MW) solar projects.
Proficiency in PVsyst, AutoCAD Electrical, and MS Project.
Strong understanding of Indian grid codes, CEA safety regulations, and BESS interfaces.
benefits: Industry-leading salary with project milestone bonuses
Dedicated site accommodation and travel per diem
Fast-track leadership growth path in our expanding Renewables division

title: Marine Operations & Vessel Coordinator
description: Coordinate offshore support vessel (OSV) charter schedules, quayside loading operations, and offshore supply chain logistics.
responsibilities: Liaise with port authorities, customs, and ship captains for vessel berthing, loading, and departure manifests.
Coordinate heavy lift crane operations, quayside staging, and bunkering of offshore supply vessels.
Monitor offshore vessel positions, voyage logs, and fuel consumptions.
Ensure full compliance with IMCA guidelines and DG Shipping regulations.
requirements: Degree or Diploma in Marine Transportation, Nautical Science, or Logistics.
3+ years experience with a shipping agency, offshore operator, or port stevedore.
Strong familiarity with Mumbai Port Trust (MbPT) and JNPT operational protocols.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills under high-pressure turnaround schedules.
benefits: Competitive compensation with port deployment allowances
Medical insurance and annual health checkups
Comprehensive maritime safety training and gear
